claim_relevant_visible_text: Solidigm D5-P5336 61.44TB PCIe 4 QLC U.2 15mm <0.5 DWPD | 9
researcher_paraphrase: VAST Data’s July 2026 SMC Gen2 EBox manufacturer BOM lists nine Solidigm D5-P5336 61.44TB PCIe 4 QLC U.2 drives per EBox.
precision_guard: This is later-known 2026 platform BOM evidence. It must not be backdated into the December 2024 EBox configuration or used to infer that the nine 30TB drives named in 2024 were P5336/QLC.
authority_boundary: VAST Data is platform-primary for the BOM and supported configuration it publishes; the page establishes current platform integration, not the first qualification date or a 2024 deployment date.
